description: This file declares the CasimirController class used for NFC and RF packet communication, including methods for connecting via TCP or Unix socket, sending and receiving RF packets, and performing NFC operations.

classes.name: CasimirController
classes.description: A controller class for managing RF and NFC communication, including connection, configuration, and data transmission.

methods.name: ConnectToTcpPort
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a TCP port for RF communication.

methods.name: ConnectToUnixSocket
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Unix socket for RF communication.

methods.name: SetPowerLevel
methods.description: Sets the power level for RF transmission.

methods.name: SendBroadcast
methods.description: Sends a broadcast RF packet with specified parameters.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Polls for NFC-A and ISO-DEP responses.

methods.name: SendApdu
methods.description: Sends an APDU command to a receiver identified by receiver_id.

methods.name: CasimirController (private constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a CasimirController instance with a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: SelectNfcA
methods.description: Selects NFC-A and returns the sender ID.

methods.name: SelectT4AT
methods.description: Selects T4AT by NFC-A listener using ISO-DEP protocol.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes with a timeout.

methods.name: ReadRfPacket
methods.description: Reads an RF packet with a timeout.
